question.text: Changes in Strategy and/or benchmark for an IA shall be:

answer.text: Recorded with proper justification and verified in annual audit under PM Regs 2020
Decided by a single fund manager

explanation.text: The Logic: Under the PM Regulations, Strategy and/or benchmark changes for an IA must be recorded with proper justification and verified in the annual audit. The Trap: Silent or undocumented changes breach the PM Regulations. Note: Recording the justification at the time of the change is what makes the annual audit verification meaningful; undocumented strategy or benchmark shifts breach the PM Regulations, 2020.
